state.intent: Integrate a newly published AMD quarter and management outlook into the existing calm visual morning board.
catalog: News & company earnings: existing numbered ResearchSection
Up to three source-linked development cards per instrument
Compact reported revenue and GAAP EPS rows
GuidancePanel with range bounds, source dates and assumptions disclosure
Saved edition selector that uses only the chosen immutable snapshot

tokens.colors: Existing panel, text, secondary, muted and border CSS variables in both themes

facts.outlook: FY2026 Q4 management revenue midpoint $17bn +/-3%, arithmetic bounds $16.49-17.51bn

constraints: AMD context is scoped to MARKET, SPY and QQQ; not a direct DIA, IWM or TLT company result
Keep older company rows and source dates; no changes to prior archived editions
Actuals and management outlook are separate, neither is analyst consensus or a measured price reaction
New facts are dated nonvoting context; retain all consensus abstentions
Remove the completed AMD release from the current upcoming calendar; do not invent its next earnings date
Reuse existing typography and interaction patterns; no new hero, animations, provider widgets or third-party scripts

placement.instructions: Choose how to present the new reported quarter and outlook within this established hierarchy.

criteria.existing_rows: Add AMD to existing reported-company rows and existing management-outlook list inside News & company earnings, preserving distinct actual and outlook headings.
criteria.issuer_card: Within the same disclosure, add one AMD card with internally separated actual and outlook subsections, keeping the existing lists for other issuers.
criteria.section_subtab: Add an issuer subtab control inside the earnings disclosure and put AMD actuals and outlook under its own tab.
criteria.expand_candidates: None of these choices fit; expand candidates before implementing.

news_order.instructions: Choose the order of the three visible source-linked development cards for views to which the new release applies.

criteria.latest_first: Show the newly verified AMD release first, then the latest labor release and previous Apple quarter; retain other saved developments in evidence.
criteria.macro_first: Keep labor first, then AMD, then Apple.
criteria.company_group: Show AMD and Apple first, then labor so company cards sit together.
